description: Safe-by-default MCP server for Microsoft Outlook mail (Microsoft Graph) — read, search, draft, send, reply, forward and organize email, with browser sign-in.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_event

tool_signatures.name: create_draft
tool_signatures.description: Create a draft message in the Drafts folder without sending it. Safe to use freely — nothing leaves the mailbox until a human sends the draft from their client. Returns the created draft (including its id).

tool_signatures.name: create_drive_folder
tool_signatures.description: Create a new folder inside a OneDrive folder (by parent

tool_signatures.name: create_event

tool_signatures.name: delete_drive_item
tool_signatures.description: Delete a OneDrive file or folder by id. It goes to the OneDrive recycle bin (recoverable), not a permanent purge. Requires admin mode and OUTLOOK_ALLOW_DELETE=true, and prompts for human confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: delete_event
tool_signatures.description: Delete an event from the calendar. If you organize it, Graph sends cancellations to attendees. Requires admin mode and OUTLOOK_ALLOW_DELETE=true, and prompts for confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: delete_message
tool_signatures.description: Delete a message by id. It is moved to the Deleted Items folder (recoverable from there), not permanently purged. Requires admin mode and OUTLOOK_ALLOW_DELETE=true, and prompts for human confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: download_drive_file
tool_signatures.description: Download a OneDrive file

tool_signatures.name: forward_mail
tool_signatures.description: Forward an existing message to new recipients with an optional comment. Gated by OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND=true and a human confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: get_drive_item
tool_signatures.description: Fetch metadata for a single OneDrive file or folder by

tool_signatures.name: get_event
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one event by id, with its full body, attendees, recurrence and online-meeting details.

tool_signatures.name: get_free_busy
tool_signatures.description: Check availability (free/busy) for one or more people over a time window — useful before proposing a meeting time. Returns each address

tool_signatures.name: get_message
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single message by id with its full body, recipients (to/cc/bcc), importance, and conversation id. Get ids from list_messages or search_messages.

tool_signatures.name: list_attachments
tool_signatures.description: List a message

tool_signatures.name: list_calendars
tool_signatures.description: List the calendars in the mailbox (id, name, owner, whether you can edit). Needs the Calendars scope.

tool_signatures.name: list_contacts
tool_signatures.description: List the mailbox

tool_signatures.name: list_drive_items
tool_signatures.description: List the files and folders in a OneDrive folder. Give a

tool_signatures.name: list_events
tool_signatures.description: List events, newest window first. Give

tool_signatures.name: list_folders
tool_signatures.description: List the mailbox

tool_signatures.name: list_messages
tool_signatures.description: List messages, most recent first. Optionally scope to a folder and/or only unread messages. Returns compact summaries (id, subject, from, received, isRead, hasAttachments, preview). Fetch full bodies with get_message.

tool_signatures.name: mark_read
tool_signatures.description: Mark a message as read or unread. Reversible.

tool_signatures.name: move_drive_item
tool_signatures.description: Move a OneDrive file or folder to another folder and/or rename it. Give the item id, and a new parent folder id and/or a new name. Reversible.

tool_signatures.name: move_message
tool_signatures.description: Move a message to another mail folder (by id or well-known name such as archive, deleteditems). Reversible: the message keeps its content and can be moved back. The destination folder is subject to the folder allowlist.

tool_signatures.name: reply_mail
tool_signatures.description: Reply to an existing message (optionally reply-all) with a comment. Gated by OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND=true and a human confirmation. Get the message id from list_messages or search_messages.

tool_signatures.name: respond_to_event
tool_signatures.description: Accept, decline, or tentatively accept a meeting invitation. A response is sent to the organizer, so it is gated by OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND=true and a confirmation.

tool_signatures.name: search_drive_files
tool_signatures.description: Search across OneDrive for files and folders matching a query (name/content).

tool_signatures.name: search_messages
tool_signatures.description: Full-text search across the mailbox (subject, body, sender, recipients) using Microsoft Graph $search. Example queries:

tool_signatures.name: send_mail
tool_signatures.description: Compose and send a new email immediately. Gated by OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND=true and a human confirmation prompt — a sent message cannot be recalled. Use create_draft instead if you only want to prepare a message.

tool_signatures.name: update_event
tool_signatures.description: Update fields of an existing event (time, subject, body, location, attendees, online-meeting). Attendees are notified of changes, so it is gated by OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND=true and a confirmation. Only the fields you pass change.

tool_signatures.name: upload_drive_file
tool_signatures.description: Create or overwrite a text file in OneDrive at the given path (≤4 MB). Parent folders in the path are created as needed. Reversible-ish: an overwritten file

tool_signatures.name: whoami
tool_signatures.description: Return the signed-in mailbox
